objective: Define a bounded alpha-useful between-Session Campaign Activity layer over existing owning domains without a generic mutation engine or unlimited future downtime breadth.
design_findings: Campaign Activity is orchestration; owning domains commit effects.
Initial bounded families cover preparation/logistics, training/advancement prep, research/investigation, journal/notes, relationship/social maintenance, crafting/repair and recovery/upkeep.
Broad business/kingdom/market/autonomous NPC/unrestricted background systems are deferred.
Every task is classified informational, immediate-domain-command, proposal-required, timed-project-progress, human-choice-required, GM-adjudication-required or prohibited.
Projects are durable aggregates, not countdown fields.
Campaign time supports profiles and never advances from wall-clock by default.
Asset/resource/facility reservations remain owning-domain authority and prevent double-spend.
Training completion does not auto-advance Character.
Research progress cannot reveal hidden clues or make hypotheses fact.
Relationship work cannot automate human consent or GM-required NPC response.
Crafting requires explicit recipes and A8 authority.
APM-02 receives routine/time/budget/stop-condition seams without automation authority.
next_action: Open bounded APW-03 governance PR, run exact-head AIOC repository-health, merge after PASS, then close APW-03 and select APW-04.
